title: 招
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved L465 handoff. 招 zhao1 ㄓㄠ; 期 qi2 ㄑㄧˊ; 招待 and 等待 use 待 dai4 ㄉㄞˋ; S03 還在 uses hai2 ㄏㄞˊ. 牌式呼絕昨 and all other out-of-ceiling Han are forbidden. S01 must use the fixed Xiaoyue and Xiaoguang references. No readable text or number image exception. R057/R058 are future Release sequencing work and are not part of this package.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 白天下午，主角女孩在自己家客廳招待固定同學小月與小光，主動端出水果或點心，邀請朋友坐下。主角媽媽可在背景照看，但招待的主動者必須是女孩，不改成媽媽招待成年朋友。小月、小光依各自固定 reference，不畫成 generic classmates。星期日由句子交代。
